provinceDeepAtlasProfile.oneLine: Zal’tharuun is centered at -60.995070, -104.773998 under Tribal Confederation, with 81,309,000 people across 14 settlements.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.extremeAtlasDescription: Zal’tharuun occupies 10,763,398.02 sq mi / 27,877,072.91 sq km of modeled Earth-sized territory, about 5.465387% of Belavadös's surface. It is not merely a province but a continent-scale civic machine: Beach and grass with water, Ocean Surface floating settlement and Farming define its broad terrain, while its settlements intensify into Ocean Surface floating settlement, Beach and grass with water, Hybrid tree and forest floor, Underwater without reefs, Partial forest, and 1 more. Population density is 2.917 people/sq km / 7.554 people/sq mi, which lets wilderness, roads, faction-held corridors, and vast uncrowded borders remain huge.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.peopleFactionsAndFaith: The strongest public people-groups are Humans, Near-Humans, and Mixed Heritage, Halfling and Smallfolk, Animalfolk and Mammalian Anthropomorphs, Amphibious and Aquatic Peoples, Elf Parent Race and Elf Bloodlines, Elemental and Energy-Born Peoples, and 2 more. Frequently recorded peoples include Human, Halfling — Lightfoot Halfling, Triton, Elf — Sea Elf, Tortle, Genasi — Water Genasi, Hadozee, Merfolk, and 4 more. Faction visibility leans toward The Obsidian Diadem, with worship and patronage records naming Nebyrr, Enkirael, Freyseth, Ishtanora, Iskareth, Bastveig, Sigrananna, and 3 more.
provinceDeepAtlasProfile.groupLinkDescription: The province participates in 5 recorded four-province geography group links, including 4 cross-transportation-group links. These links place it inside overlapping regional corridors rather than one isolated block, allowing border-adjacent transit, faction influence, and cultural spillover to breathe across group lines.

npcs.name: Rylee Brassroad
npcs.description:
Rylee Brassroad is a restless Ombrask trade broker who left protected vault-life because safety started feeling too much like a cage. Her shadow-born nature makes her private, perceptive, and hard to pin down, with Eirzunet’s influence showing in her talent for secrecy, illusion, twilight movement, and noticing when a “perfectly legal” shipment is hiding something rotten.
At the Thal’zuroth Watch Office, Rylee works with the Brass Concordat to inspect contracts, broker trading-emporium stock, and confront suppliers whose goods are poisoning customers or masking black-market ichor contamination. She is practical, suspicious, quietly brave, and eager for a larger life, but she still carries the wary habits of someone who knows that sheltered communities can hide corruption just as easily as open roads can. Thal’zuroth is one of Zal’tharuun’s cities, and the province’s mountain underlayers make her trade routes especially tangled with cavern markets, hidden courts, and dangerous supply politics.
npcs.settlementAndAncestryTexture: Thal’zuroth is a City in Zal’tharuun, under Tribal Confederation, with severe danger, Underwater without reefs terrain. Local records favor Neutral, Neutral, Cooperative, Honorable civic habits; common communities include Triton, Merfolk, Locathah, Tamhiogal, Dril'thar — Ocean. Ombrask reads through the Ombrask entry of the race compendium, within Shadow, Umbral, and Darkness-Aligned Peoples, marked by Eirzunet. Shadow-bodied beings that exist partially outside physical reality, appearing as shifting silhouettes. They are natural infiltrators who thrive in secrecy and illusion. Table cues: Dexterity +2, Additional +1, Darkvision, Fade Away; starting tendency Selfish - Chaotic - Combative - Pragmatic.
rumors: Rylee Brassroad knows why an ichor ledger changed hands last Sigranday.
Rylee Brassroad has a contact in Faelmere who will deny everything.
plotHooks: Rylee Brassroad asks the party to protect a household member without revealing why.
A rival faction offers proof that Rylee Brassroad's public story is incomplete.
